from rcb_traj import Session
import numpy as np
from envs.utils import ArmTag

s = Session('move_can_pot', instance='/app/instance.json')
env = s.env
arm = env.arm_tag
assert arm == 'right', f'Unexpected frozen arm: {arm}'

# The frozen can starts lying on its side with the required Euler x/y orientation.
# Translate its center to the task's side-of-pot target, preserving that orientation.
can_start = np.asarray(env.can.get_pose().p, dtype=float).copy()
target = np.asarray(env.target_pose.p, dtype=float).copy()
xy_delta = target[:2] - can_start[:2]

s.record_start()

# Ensure the active hand is ready, approach and grasp the can, then carry it above
# the pot handles while translating to the target. Lower it back to table height.
assert env.move(env.open_gripper(arm))
assert env.move(env.grasp_actor(env.can, arm, pre_grasp_dis=0.10, grasp_dis=0.0))
assert env.plan_success, 'grasp plan failed'
assert env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=0.10, move_axis='world'))
assert env.plan_success, 'lift plan failed'
assert env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, x=float(xy_delta[0]), y=float(xy_delta[1]), move_axis='world'))
assert env.plan_success, 'translation plan failed'
assert env.move(env.move_by_displacement(arm, z=-0.10, move_axis='world'))
assert env.plan_success, 'lower plan failed'
assert env.move(env.open_gripper(arm))
assert env.move(env.open_gripper(ArmTag('left')))

actions = s.record_stop()
print('recorded', actions.shape, 'status', s.status())
print('can final', np.asarray(env.can.get_pose().p), np.asarray(env.can.get_pose().q))
print('pot final', np.asarray(env.pot.get_pose().p))

replay_status = s.replay(actions)
print('replay', replay_status)
if not replay_status['success']:
    raise RuntimeError('Recorded trajectory does not pass replay success predicate')
s.save_trajectory(actions, '/app/output/trajectory.npz', meta={'task': 'move_can_pot', 'approach': 'grasp, lift, translate to beside-pot target, lower, release'})
print('saved /app/output/trajectory.npz')
